theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_bml_rescaled_portmanteau
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (a : Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts ν → (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → Tendsto (fun j => (lams j)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∫ x, g (dilation a (lams j) x) ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, g x ∂ν))) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → limsup (fun j => ENNReal.ofReal ((lams j)⁻¹ ^ 2) * μ (dilation a (lams j) ⁻¹' K)) atTop ≤ ν K) ∧ ∀ U : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen U → ν U ≤ liminf (fun j => ENNReal.ofReal ((lams j)⁻¹ ^ 2) * μ (dilation a (lams j) ⁻¹' U)) atTop
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
